title: Registration and orientation
summary: Orientation is delivered once per session and again after a context restart (SessionStart clear or compact on Claude and Codex, preCompact on Cursor). Each attempt is claimed under a per-session lock, so parallel hooks such as Cursor's concurrent postToolUse deliver it once; an undelivered request settles its claim lost for the next event to repair. It confirms delivery only after context emission. Each harness writes the exact merged and budgeted context body's UTF-8 byte_count and SHA-256 into the existing delivered marker, without storing the body. Receiving QA reads the marker on its retained host through qa mission host-command, including Cursor where transcripts omit hook bodies. Emission evidence remains distinct from native receiving proof, which waits for released QA.
